provider: Hugging Face Storage Buckets via S3 gateway (s3.hf.co) — as an annex/DVC backend
category: S3-compatible object storage (Hugging Face Storage Buckets through the s3.hf.co gateway)

free_tier.stated: Free user or organisation: public storage 'Best-effort' with no published figure, private storage 100 GB; the storage plans and policies apply to every repository type, buckets included
free_tier.notes: above the first few gigabytes of public storage the page asks for content of value to other users and names abuse mitigations without a figure; PRO, Team and Enterprise plans carry numeric public and private limits

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the 500 GB per-file hard limit on the storage-limits page is stated in a section marked as not applying to Storage Buckets, and the bucket and S3 gateway pages publish no per-object limit
per_object_cap.notes: Git-backed model, dataset and Space repositories keep the 500 GB per-file hard limit

retention.stated: unverified: the bucket, S3 gateway and storage-limits pages state no expiry or inactivity rule for stored objects; incomplete multipart uploads expire after 7 days
retention.notes: buckets are non-versioned: a delete is immediate and unrecoverable

egress.terms: Egress and CDN are included in the storage price up to a ratio of 8:1 to total storage; the storage page publishes no price or action above the ratio. GetObject through the single-region S3 gateway usually answers with a redirect to the nearest Hugging Face CDN edge rather than serving the bytes itself.

tooling: Any S3 client: AWS CLI, boto3, s5cmd; `hf` CLI (`hf sync`, `hf buckets`); python `huggingface_hub`. For this slot: `git annex initremote type=S3 host=s3.hf.co region=us-east-1 requeststyle=path` (annex needs path-style, which the gateway requires anyway) and `dvc remote add ... ; dvc remote modify myremote endpointurl https://s3.hf.co/<namespace>`. S3 creds are derived from an HF token via 'Generate S3 credentials' (HFAK... key).
chaining: Buckets are non-versioned, so a versioning layer on top of the S3 gateway keeps history: DVC is documented as a bucket remote through the gateway, and other S3 clients that take a custom endpoint with path-style addressing reach it the same way; storage is deduplicated at chunk level by Xet, and reads go out through the included CDN.

limits.value: private storage 100 GB on a free user or organisation; public storage 'Best-effort' with no published figure
egress included up to 8:1 of total storage

limits_note: The S3 gateway is single-region (us-east-1), path-style only and ListObjectsV2 only, and does not parse aws-chunked trailing checksums (request_checksum_calculation and response_checksum_validation set to when_required); ACLs, bucket policies, object tagging, object versioning, lifecycle rules, server-side encryption and bucket notifications are not supported, user metadata is not stored, server-side copy works within one namespace only, and incomplete multipart uploads expire after 7 days; 2 GB multipart parts are recommended. The per-file and file-count figures on the storage-limits page are stated for Git-backed repositories only.

identity_cost.detail: the join form asks an email address and a password; free-tier accounts exist with no credit card on file, and a card is asked for PRO, Team, paid compute and storage above the free tier; whether a later step of the join form asks a phone number is unverified

reliability_note: Public storage on a free account is 'Best-effort': above the first few gigabytes the page names abuse mitigations without a figure; bucket deletions are immediate and unrecoverable; the S3 gateway is single-region (us-east-1).
